subject_group: 6.1.11 Vertical/Short Takeoff and Landing (V/STOL) air vehicles

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that V/STOL dynamic response characteristics have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.7.2 V/STOL dynamic response requirements. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.
